channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about James Harden | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about James Harden from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on James Harden
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell on James Harden:

“I just truly believe the only reason why he’s not talked about in every room is because of championship conversation. But I’ve always known it being around him, but when you’re his teammate, I think it grew to a whole different level. Seeing him in camp, seeing his influence on the group, seeing his conversation, seeing his passion behind winning, and passion behind intention and trying to be the best of what he does, really puts in perspective how BS a lot of narratives are, and how you really don’t truly understand something until you see it from the other side.”

Donovan Mitchell on James Harden, Oct 7, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Evan Mobley on James Harden
item.description:
Evan Mobley on James Harden:

“Like you said, a legend. It’s crazy that I get to play with him and be around him every day and learn from him. It’s surreal in a way. But as I get to know him every single day, he’s a great guy, just a normal dude just like all of us. I feel that’s a big factor that a lot of people hold people on pedestals, but he’s just a normal guy just like all of us. I feel that gives everyone else confidence that he has a good personality, natural personality, and gets along with everyone. He’s not trying to big-time anyone or anything like that.”

Evan Mobley on James Harden, Oct 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Peyton Watson, James Harden
item.description:
Koby Altman and Kenny Atkinson on James Harden:

“He wanted us to put the best roster together to win a championship. He helped us recruit Peyton Watson. He helped us get under the first apron. He wants to win. He’s been unselfish since he arrived here.”

Kenny Atkinson on Peyton Watson, James Harden, Sep 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Derik Queen on LeBron James, James Harden
item.description:
Derik Queen:

“Really James Harden. When I wanted to learn how to dribble, he was on the Rockets doing his one-on-one stuff. Even Oklahoma City, I caught the later years of OKC. But when he was on the Rockets, he just used to do his one-on-one and I was just like, I want to do that. Him and LeBron are my favorite players. LeBron, I'm not athletic like him, but all three of us can pass. Those two were my favorite, so I just try to play like them, but at a different size and I'm not fast like them. I still fry you though.”

Derik Queen on LeBron James, James Harden, Sep 15, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“I signed a three-year $40 million contract with the Clippers. I turned down a three-year $50 million with Sacramentojust to stay with the Clippers. For me to be there, all the great guards they've had, I was part of that starting five that helped the Clippers go to the first time ever Western Conference Finals. They've had great guards. They've had James Harden, they had Russell Westbrook, they have Chris Paul, they've had Rajon Rondo. They had a plethora of point guards that just can never help them get over the hump, but I was part of that starting five that helped them finally, first time ever, and they haven't been back since, get to the Western Conference Finals.”

Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Sep 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Bob McAdoo, James Harden
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Mike D'Antoni on coaching James Harden:

“I remember when I went and told him he was going to run the offense as the point guard I'm sure he was channeling his inner Bob McAdoo and thought coach just give me the effing ball. He's one of the most skilled players I've ever coached, and I appreciate the trust he gave me. Thank you, James”

Mike D'Antoni on Bob McAdoo, James Harden, Aug 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Steve Kerr, James Harden
item.description:
D'Antoni on the James Harden and Chris Paul Rockets:

“We thought we were the best team in the league by far that year for sure. And we had Golden State on the ropes, with their Big 3 -- Big 4, actually, they'll probably have four Hall-of-Fame guys going in. They were good, and Steve Kerr does a great job. We had 'em, you know? We had 'em, and just, Chris [Paul] got hurt, and that's just the way it goes. And then we missed 27 3s in a row, which didn't help. Analytically, I know that's not good! I knew it wasn't when we were doing it, but just a great team.”

Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Steve Kerr, James Harden, Aug 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Marc Spears on James Harden
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Marc Spears on where things stand between James Harden and the Cavs:

“The Cavaliers are working through different iterations of a deal, trying to come up with something that's best for James and also best for them. And to James' credit, they're saying that he's been patient his people has been patient, and I hear that they expect aresolution to come soon for him to re-sign”

Marc Spears on James Harden, Aug 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Byron Scott on LeBron James, James Harden, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Byron Scott on LeBron James:

“If they didn't have James Harden, I think he would have did it a third time. But then again, we also heard reports that Donovan Mitchell wasn't a good fit with LeBron.”

Byron Scott on LeBron James, James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, Aug 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on James Harden
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Donovan Mitchell on James Harden:

“I'm appreciative of him because he helped me get somewhere that I've never been before. We live in a world where it's just so much easier to knock and hate. To see it firsthand, the work ethic, the passion, the IQ, the leadership, it's just like man just gets a bad rep”

Donovan Mitchell on James Harden, May 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on James Harden
item.description:
#CavsDonovan Mitchell on James Harden:

“I hope he is back. He helped myself and this group get somewhere we have never been”

Donovan Mitchell on James Harden, May 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on James Harden
item.description:
“When I was in Golden State and we played Houston, we counted James Harden’s dribbles,”

Mike Brown on James Harden, May 20, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on James Harden
item.description:
J.B. Bickerstaff on James Harden:

“He has an unbelievable ability to manipulate what the rules are. We would play 1 on 1 when I coached in Houston and he would foul bait me.”

JB Bickerstaff on James Harden, May 16, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: RJ Barrett on James Harden
item.description:
Barrett on the altercation with Harden:

“I take everything as disrespect. Don’t walk over to our bench and pick the ball up. James Harden is a guy I have tremendous respect for… but who cares right now.”

RJ Barrett on James Harden, Apr 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on James Harden
item.description:
Cavaliers coach Kenny Atkinson on James Harden’s durability and production:

“This is new for me. I’ve never had so much confidence in playing a guy.”

Kenny Atkinson on James Harden, Mar 31, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Harden
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“If you put your arm in, everybody around the league will do what Shai does, what James Harden does. Like, they'll hook your arm, and they'll [flail their arms], and it's all part of the rules. So, more power to all the individual players. But as a league, we need to adapt and adjust. The players are just, year after year, they just take advantage of the rules. They're smart, and they know what they're doing.”

Steve Kerr on James Harden, Mar 8, 2026. Source: NBC Bay Area.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on James Harden
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Kenny Atkinson on James Harden:

“The elite IQ, the elite passing skills. He's one of the decision makers of all time in my mind. He always makes the right read. He's in that Lebron territory where he can get you 40 or get 20 assists”

Kenny Atkinson on James Harden, Feb 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on James Harden
item.description:
Law Murray:Lawrence Frank on James Harden:

“James exceeded all our expectations... obviously we weren't looking to trade James, but we came together, had very honest conversations about what the next couple years look like for us”

Lawrence Frank on James Harden, Feb 9, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on James Harden
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on James Harden:

“He was a great teammate. We spent time together. Had great memories. I wish him the best of luck with him and his career. We’re still locked in. And I respect him.”

Kawhi Leonard on James Harden, Feb 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Koby Altman on James Harden
item.description:
Altman on Harden cont'd:

“...And so that excited me even more, the fact that he knew our depth chart really well. And so, all of that together, obviously made us pull the trigger on that.”

Koby Altman on James Harden, Feb 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cam Christie on James Harden
item.description:
Cam Christie, on now ex-Clipper James Harden:

“He was great for me and great for everybody on the team. Did a great job of being a leader and it’s sad to see him go. But, obviously, excited to see what he can do over in Cleveland and wish him the best of luck over there.”

Cam Christie on James Harden, Feb 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on James Harden
item.description:
Ty Lue on James Harden:

“Everybody knows James was great for us. His ability to make guys better, play every single night…He was really a great guy. Everybody loved him. Organization, players. He was a rockstar.”

Tyronn Lue on James Harden, Feb 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on James Harden
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on the James Harden trade reports:

“It’s a surprise… Respect his decision. Or whoever’s decision it is. That’s still gonna be my boy. Trust the front office.”

Kawhi Leonard on James Harden, Feb 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Harden, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Coty M. Davis:#Warriors coach Steve Kerr on #Pistons Cade Cunningham:

“He's awesome. He reminds me of Luka and James Harden. Just kind of a one-man offense, running everything through him. He's a great, great player, really coming into his own.”

Steve Kerr on James Harden, Cade Cunningham, Jan 30, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: John Collins on James Harden, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Collins:

“Consistency. You can count on them to come up big in big moments. I feel like that means just as much as anything, as any part of basketball. If you need somebody to step up or you need somebody to call upon, I feel like those two dudes are so equipped and so experienced for any situation. That sort of relaxes me a little bit. Just being able to look over there and see Kawhi Leonard and James Harden and know that those guys have been through the trenches and are still here and staying strong. These ‘Uncs’ can still hoop. They’re still going hard. They’re still at the top of their game. Of course, some hometown nods shouldn’t hurt.”

John Collins on James Harden, Kawhi Leonard, Jan 27, 2026. Source: Essentially Sports.

item.title: Sergio Llull on James Harden
item.description:
The Real Madrid legend even told the YouTube show TIMEOUT - Basketball Channel last summer that Harden personally called him to come to the Rockets, who offered him a three-year, $17 million contract , according to reports in the United States at the time.

“I had a very good season and we were on a winning streak. I was close to leaving; a delegation from the Rockets came and we went out to dinner. During dinner, they put James Harden on the phone. I left that dinner saying, ‘I’m going,’ I was almost convinced,”

Sergio Llull on James Harden, Jan 17, 2026. Source: Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on James Harden
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on James Harden passing Shaquille O’Neal to become 9th on the NBA’s all-time scoring list:

“It’s amazing to hear. Where he came from, his upbringing. Showing how much hard work. He’s an inspiration for the youth out here. Knowing that if you work hard you can get there one day. Just stay focused on the daily grind. Through all the ups and downs and everything. It’s very hard. Congratulations to him.”

Kawhi Leonard on James Harden, Jan 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on James Harden
item.description:
The clip was shown at Intuit Dome during intermission and quickly caught attention.

“Happy New Year. And I have a New Year's resolution for my teammate, James Harden. I want to see if he could eat food without getting it in his beard,”

Kawhi Leonard on James Harden, Jan 2, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Jeff Teague on James Harden
item.description:
However, recently, former NBA All-Star Jeff Teague took to his Club 520 podcast to drop some advice for Houston on how to get better in that department.

“They need to trade for James Harden… Tell James you want him to play like he was in Brooklyn. Be the point guard… Him and [Kevin Durant] being together… They got a real chance,”

Jeff Teague on James Harden, Dec 23, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on James Harden, Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Tyronn Lue:

“We don’t have a lot of point-of-attack offensive guys that can create their own shots, so we rely on James [Harden], we rely on [Ivica Zubac] to make those guys better and get those guys open shots. The other guys gotta step up and shoot them with confidence.”

Tyronn Lue on James Harden, Ivica Zubac, Nov 20, 2025. Source: x.com.
